newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela recovery will be led by private sector.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela recovery will be led by private sector.

text.p: Venezuelan economic recovery will be led by the private sector and not by increased government spending, Trade and Commerce Minister Freddy Rojas Parra said.

"Economic reactivation, when it comes, will be led by private international and domestic capital and not sped along by increased government spending," Rojas told a press conference on Sunday at the Presidential residence, La Casona.
Venezuelan economic growth is expected to top four percent in 1997. "But this year there will be no growth in the non-oil sector and I don't want to create false expectations," Rojas added.
